label: ic.pipeline: a factor base sized to r (size=auto, B = 0.5 r^(1/3)) against the fixed B = 32, prime ladder 2^18..2^28
description: Does sizing the prime-abscissa base as B = 0.5 r^(1/3) move ic.pipeline (pair-table MITM oracle, incremental Gauss) from its fixed-base exponent alpha = 1 to the m = 2 family's r^(2/3)? Incumbent: the frontier's fixed B = 32 cell with an A/A control; matched rho: rho.negation_v2 and rho.negation_v3 on the same curves and targets. Counted GAE; the linear algebra's row operations and the table probes are unpriced and enter through the AGENTS.md 5a band. Local L0 host.
